question: In January 2020, Indian Navy launched Operation _______ to provide humanitarian assistance and disaster relief in Madagascar.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vanilla**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In January 2020, the Indian Navy launched ‘Operation Vanilla’ to provide assistance to the cyclone-affected population of Madagascar.
 
• At Madagascar port, the INS Airavat has arrived on January 30.
 
• Cyclone Diane has caused flooding in Madagascar.
 
• Around 92,000 people have been displaced, besides causing the loss of lives.
 
• The relief materials were provided by the INS Airavat.
 
• In the southern Indian Ocean, INA Airavat was deployed initially.
 
• Later INS Airavat was sent to Madagascar for relief operations.
 
• Blankets, food, clothing and medicine are comprised in the relief materials of Indian naval ship.
 
• The assistance of India to Madagascar is in consonance with the Indian Navy's Foreign Cooperation initiatives in line with the Prime Minister's vision of 'Security and Growth for all in the Region (SAGAR)'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Operation Pineapple** was the name given to a **standoff between the United States and North Korea over the Indian Ocean**. The encounter resulted in the shootdown of a US F-14 Tomcat by the North Korean squad, who outnumbered the US squadron by two jets.
 
• **Operation Shanti** was the** Indian Army on a peace mission in Egypt, 1956-1967.**
